description: Predict (log) residential price per square metre (Sberbank). Industry tabular data with an official temporal train/valid/test split (TabReD, NeurIPS 2024 D&B).

metadata.citation: Rubachev et al., TabReD, NeurIPS 2024 Datasets & Benchmarks (arXiv 2406.19380)
metadata.temporal_split_note: Rows are i.i.d. tabular records; the official split is temporal (distribution shift).
metadata.contamination_note: Industry dataset, far less common than UCI/OpenML; low LLM-memorisation risk.

split_strategy.rationale: Honour TabReD's official temporal train/valid/test split.
